Bidder should be uploaded oem authorization and oem turnover along with bid documents. 19. Warranty Certificate/Declaration will have to upload along the BID. In case of any change, the financial bid will not be opened. 20. The bidder will have to upload affidavit an on a stamp paper of Rs. 100 along with department/organization name as of date bid published and also notarized as same the tender to the effect that he is not blacklisted in any government institution and if the documents uploaded by him are found to be wrong, then the department will be free to take action to cancel his tender and put it in the black list and the deposited heritage security money will be confiscated and legal action will be taken. The tendering firm will be responsible for the same. 23. The bidder must produce an affidavit on non-judicial stamp of Rs. 100 stating department/ organization name as of date bid published and also notarized as same that the near relation of the following departmental officers employed in the ULB/Elected Member of Nagar Nigam, Nagar Palika, Nagar Panchayat, Municipal Commissioner, CE, EE, EO, J.ES, A.E.S, DAOs and other clerical staff) clearly mentioning the names and designation of relatives working in any capacity in the Department along with Posting Place for award and execution of work. A bidder shall not be permitted to bid for works in the Division responsible for award and execution of contracts in which his/her or his/her spouses near relatives (defined as first blood relations and their spouses) is posted in any capacity such as Divisional Accountant Officer, other clerical staff or as an officer in any capacity between the grades. 23. It will be mandatory to upload a color scanned copy of all types of records/documents with the tender; otherwise, the tender will not be considered. 24. Bidders are required to submit hardcopy of the complete documents before bid opening date, otherwise bid will be considered null and void. 25. again. If less than three firms pass the technical qualification when opening bids for the second time, a decision regarding the opening of financial bids will be made by the competent authority.
